title: Michael Vale Exhibition at MPRG
summary: Solo show by Michael Vale at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery, running alongside New Wave 26. Free entry, weekends 11am to 4pm.
nearbyAttractions: Mornington Main Street; New Wave 26 exhibition (same gallery)
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with New Wave 26 at same venue; then lunch on Main Street
editorVerdict: Worth an hour if you're already in Mornington, a special trip only if Vale is on your list.
editorNote:
A solo show by Australian painter Michael Vale tucked into MPRG's program alongside the bigger New Wave 26 survey. The pairing is the point: two rooms, two different conversations, one ticket (free) and you're back on Main Street for lunch inside ninety minutes.

Go on a wet Saturday when the foreshore is a write-off and the gallery is at its best, quiet, warm and properly lit. Take the kids if they'll tolerate a gallery; the family activity space at MPRG genuinely helps.

Weekends 11am to 4pm, closes 31 May. No booking, no charge.
kidsGradeNote: Fine for school-age kids who can handle a gallery for thirty minutes; the family activity space helps with the smaller ones.
